_comment: Source of truth for the Rating & Review System (issue #7). Keyed by '{entityType}/{owner}/{repo}/{name}' — e.g. 'skill/dan323/easier-life-skills/changelog'. Any entity type (skill, agent, plugin, hook, command, mcpServer, bundle) from any repo can be rated. The build merges this into skills_index.json; the ingest script (scripts/ingest-ratings.ts) rewrites this file from the 'Ratings' GitHub Discussion category on each CI run.

value.avg: number — mean of reviews[].stars, rounded to one decimal
